text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Finally! Finally, my four divine
generals have gathered!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital! Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer! Daitaku Helios!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And standing at the top—Demon Queen
Windy! We're unbeatable!
Nothing will get
in our way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk, we've still much to do, my
liege!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She's right. We could use even more
hands. You've laid out all of your
plans in
painstaking detail, so I think it's gonna be
a pretty big task.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think we'd want to get at least ten more
people on board.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ten?! It took us long enough to just find
four!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Errrm. B-but you know, Palmer and Helios
were the only ones to
express even slight
interest in our flyers...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Dwelling in the shadows as I am
wont to do, I'm afraid I won't
be much
help...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We'll turn those tsk tsks into hehes yet!
Just leave it to the new
blood! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. All right, let's do this, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! There's something going
down in the plaza! Some
people are
dressed up in costumes and handing out
candy!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, candy? Aren't they a bit early for
Halloween?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're trying to build hype for
their Solefall Faire exhibit!
Let's go check
it out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwa... BWAHAHAHA! S-something like
that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We are of Demon Queen Windy's legion!
Our ranks are recruiting
allies for the
Solefall Faire!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, candy's free for the eatin'! And
all you gotta do is give our
flyer a readin'!
Don't sleep on my crew, tell your friends
who's who,
now everybody come through
and join the legion! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Skdjsds... Such splendor! The light of the
party... It is almost too much
for my eyes
to behold!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! I'd know that duo from a mile
away. Those getups are adorbs
too. You're
rockin' 'em, gals!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! Wanna rock some threads just as
fire? You just gotta help us out
with the
Solefall Faire!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like this exhibit is all Windy's
idea. Whoa, this could
actually be pretty
fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? Feel free to drop by for a visit! Let's
make Windy's Demonic
Castle pop off!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah, so many people... I-if they all join
us...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with the ruckus? And what are
you all wearing?! The
Solefall Faire is still
well off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, crap!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Time to scram! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... That was close! We would have gotten chewed out for sure if he'd caught us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I don't think I've ever changed so fast in my life! B-but you know, that was kind of fun...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that! Didn't think we'd get shut
down so quickly. We
handed out the
flyers, but no one actually agreed to help
out...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I was hoping to join Demon Queen
Windy's legion... Is this the
right place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Yeah, you're in the right place for
sure! ...Hey, when did all of
you get here?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Turns out this is the place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, does anyone plan on using the rest of
this paint? It'll dry up if
we just leave it
here.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I managed to finish half of this blackout
curtain! Can we hang it on a
window to
make sure I got the size right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-yes! That's right, I'll be using this
lantern to guide visitors into the
castle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I see, Digitan is at your command! Just
gotta make sure everyone is
evenly spaced
out, got it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! We're gonna use every inch of
this classroom to build the
baddest
haunted castle ever! Can't wait! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The more folks who participate in the
exhibit, the larger we can make
it! But that
means we've still got plenty left to do!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Just wow...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(There's just so many people... Wow! We
should be able to make it
now...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy's Demonic Castle is definitely,
DEFINITELY gonna be a huge
success!
